answer: Cosignatures are collected in wander, verified in juniper, and sparrow names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 29 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 397 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
